HRA Analysis: EXCLUSIVE HUSTLER (1) did a lot of work last time out and ran very well there finishing third behind Smarter Than You. He looks likely to be able to drive through and lead in this race which should see him very hard to beat. AIR EXPRESS (8) should get a good run through early in this race behind the likely leader. He got back in the run last time out and was flashing into it late behind Fernco Nel. He should get the right run and will be hard to hold out late. MIRACLE MOOSE (4) got back in the run last time out and was flashing home late down the outside into sixth. He has been in excellent form and finds what appears to be a suitable race. If the race is run to suit he should be flashing home again. SMARTER THAN YOU (3) continues to race in excellent form and was able to back up an impressive win two starts ago with another good win last start when running over the top late. He should get a good run close to the speed and will be running on again. SELECTIONS: EXCLUSIVE HUSTLER (1), AIR EXPRESS (8), MIRACLE MOOSE (4), SMARTER THAN YOU (3) SUGGESTED BET: MIRACLE MOOSE (4) each way.

MISTER MANAGER (2) wasn’t quite able to show the speed last time out to hold out Borella and was left to do the work outside the leader before fading late. If he can drive through and lead this time he would likely be very hard to run down in a race of this nature. GREAT WHITE (8) appears to draw awkwardly inside the back row. He took on a strong race last time out and was left to race off the pegs on a very genuine tempo which saw him fade out of it late. He should get a softer run this time and can look to bounce back. JUST A COOL DUDE (11) got a good run off the speed last time out and was running on strongly late into second behind Borella who led all the way in that race. He should get a good run off the speed again and should be running into the finish again. MARTIN MAGIC (7) draws poorly outside the front row which could see him shuffled back a long way. He ran well last time out when getting back and running on nicely into fourth behind Amami. SELECTIONS: MISTER MANAGER (2), GREAT WHITE (8), JUST A COOL DUDE (11), MARTIN MAGIC (7) SUGGESTED BET: GREAT WHITE (8) each way.

FATE AWAITS (3) returns in this race having just been nabbed late by Final Deadline last time out after doing plenty of work in the run. He looks likely to roll straight to the lead and should make a successful return in this race. TYSON (10) was excellent through the recent Inter Dominion series which included a very close up fifth behind Minos in the second round of heats after drawing poorly on the back row. He appears to find a suitable race first up and despite the back row draw he should be thereabouts. WILLIAMS (1) has good gate speed and was able to work to the lead before handing over last start and running into second behind Dougs Flame. He should be able to secure a similar run and can look to finish in the placings again. SEASIDE GLORY (9) did plenty of work in the run last time out in the QBRED Triad final and was good battling on for fifth there. She should get a softer run off the speed this time and can be running on late. SELECTIONS: FATE AWAITS (3), TYSON (10), WILLIAMS (1), SEASIDE GLORY (9) SUGGESTED BET: WILLIAMS (1) to place.

PATH TO GREATNESS (3) ran well through the Inter Dominion series before having little luck when shuffled back in the consolation. He returns in this race from a spell and should find this a considerable drop in grade from what he has been racing. DOUGS FLAME (8) has been in terrific form recently and was able to continue that last start when powering over the top late to score. She appears likely to be suited by a soft draw inside the back row in this race and should be running on late again. ROCKNROLL WALLA (1) has good gate speed and should be able to drive through and lead before having options from there. He led last time out and ran a good second to Air Express. MY ULTIMATE FLYNN (2) drew poorly last time out which saw him shuffled back before finishing it off well into third behind Air Express. He should get a better run this time and can be running on late again. SELECTIONS: PATH TO GREATNESS (3), DOUGS FLAME (8), ROCKNROLL WALLA (1), MY ULTIMATE FLYNN (2) SUGGESTED BET: PATH TO GREATNESS (3) to win.

VINCHESKA (1) has good gate speed and should be able to drive through and lead in the early stages of this race. She ran a good third two starts ago when sitting without cover and battling on well behind Alta Sensation. She looks hard to beat. SHES IN LINE (8) should get a good run through early in this race. She did well to run third last time out when being shuffled back early at Marburg before running on widest on the track behind Saturday Dance. MULLUM RUBY (3) bounced back to form two starts ago when sitting behind the leader and proving too good late before running well again last time out. She should settle close enough in the run from a good draw and can run well again. OUT OF EDEN (2) was able to work off the pegs and roll to the lead last time out and was just run down late by the horse on her back in Pretty Little Liar. She is likely to settle close enough from a good draw and can be running on late this time. SELECTIONS: VINCHESKA (1), SHES IN LINE (8), MULLUM RUBY (3), OUT OF EDEN (2) SUGGESTED BET: VINCHESKA (1) to win.

TREMENDOUS SENSATION (1) should have the speed to drive through and lead early in this race from the ideal draw. She was able to launch across last time out and find the front before leading all the way winning impressively beating the in-form GOLDEN FIRE (4). GOLDEN FIRE (4) continued her excellent run of form last time out when flashing late to just miss behind TREMENDOUS SENSATION (1). She has excellent early speed but does draw outside of a horse which also flys the gate in TREMENDOUS SENSATION (1) and is unlikely to be able to get across her in the early stages of the race. She should be running on late again. SALLY BIGTIME (3) couldn’t quite show enough gate speed to hold up last time out when crossed in the early stages which saw her left to race off the pegs. She wasn’t beaten far there last time out and should settle close enough in the run in a small field. SHEZA BONNY SHEILA (2) with no back line in this race it looks a perfect opportunity for this horse to tuck in behind the leader and get a soft run on the leaders back. She was beaten 10 metres last time out in fast time by Fernco Nel and could be better suited in this race back to the 1660. SELECTIONS: TREMENDOUS SENSATION (1), GOLDEN FIRE (4), SALLY BIGTIME (3), SHEZA BONNY SHEILA (2) SUGGESTED BET: TREMENDOUS SENSATION (1) to win.

ATTACHMENT (6) put in another excellent run last time out when sitting without cover in open class company and simply proved too good for TIMS A TROOPER (5). He draws wide this time but does have very good gate speed and may be able to work across to the lead in this race which should see him incredibly hard to beat again. TIMS A TROOPER (5) ran well last time out when closing in strongly behind ATTACHMENT (6) at this track into second. He isn’t a horse with brilliant early speed which could see him shuffled back in what made be a sedately run race for the open class horses. FERNCO NEL (4) has very good early speed and may look to press forward and find a prominent position before handing over to his stablemate ATTACHMENT (6). He was able to score nicely last time out after being suited by a genuine early tempo at this track and trip when beating Tremendous Sensation who has since won. WISPER A SECRET (3) has good early speed and may look for a prominent position in this race. He wasn’t beaten far last time out in third by his stablemate ATTACHMENT (6) last time out and should be thereabouts again. SELECTIONS: ATTACHMENT (6), TIMS A TROOPER (5), FERNCO NEL (4), WISPER A SECRET (3) SUGGESTED BET: ATTACHMENT (6) to win.

RACANA (1) couldn’t quite show enough gate speed to hold out Pretty Little Liar before being left without cover and ran a very good second in good time. She will be doing her best in this race to hold a forward position and if she could hold the lead she would likely be very hard to run down. FEAR THE PAIN (8) should get a good run through in this race behind the likely leader of the race. She ran well last time out when finishing fourth behind Pretty Little Liar over the 2138 and with a good run in this race she should be thereabouts again. BETTORS MOON (4) was able to get a good run through early on the pegs last time out and finished fourth there behind Hes All Torque who rated good time winning. She is likely to appreciate getting back to mares company and draws reasonably in this race. PRINCESS ARNA (3) has good gate speed and will likely be looking to press forward in the early stages of this race. She was able to work to the lead last time out and took them all the way scoring a dominant win. SELECTIONS: RACANA (1), FEAR THE PAIN (8), BETTORS MOON (4), PRINCESS ARNA (3) SUGGESTED BET: FEAR THE PAIN (8) each way.

PRINCE NASEEM (7) appeared to race a bit greenly through stages of his recent trial before flashing into it late once he was pulled into the clear attacking the line for second in a 27.3 last quarter behind EXIT ELEVEL (2). The horse has been placed ODM at the trainers request which sees him draw outside the front row. CHARMED CONQUEST (4) was shuffled a long way back early last time out before running into it late behind Im El Aquero. He should get a good run close enough to the speed in the small field and can be running on late again. YIPPEE KIYAY (6) raced up on the speed last time out and just faded out of it there in a very truly run race for the 2YOs. He should get a good run off the speed and is seemingly a horse which possesses a nice turn of foot. EXIT ELEVEN (2) trialled up smartly beating PRINCE NASEEM (7) who is likely to be one of the favoured runners in this race. In his latest race start he finished it off nicely into second behind Blackjack Sam. SELECTIONS: PRINCE NASEEM (7), CHARMED CONQUEST (4),YIPPEE KIYAY (6), EXIT ELEVEN (2) SUGGESTED BET: PRINCE NASEEM (7) to win. OVERVIEW:SPEEDY HEALEY (2) looks very well placed here against this opposition based on his best form and the times he’s capable of producing. He was terrific first-up when drawing the back row and making up good ground in excellent closing fractions in a race that developed into a sprint home. The claim of Blake Pace sees him draw well, and his last win, although a year ago, came with him in the sulky. The early tempo looks good enough for him to map well and let down with his sharp sprint. WAR ZONE (9) is a more than handy 3yo who, two starts back, had a strong win at Ballarat in good time, before having a throw at the stumps in the VICBRED heats where the company was just a bit sharp. His best performances have been from a front-row draw, but he can still be in the finish if the tempo is right. FREAK OUT (6) is a good, tough, forward-going type who’s run some good races at this track and was a gallant second last time out at Melton when sitting parked. His chances would improve significantly if he found the front, but a few others will also be looking. PICKLE IT (8) gets a soft peg-line draw and will be reliant on the breaks coming at the right time but is racing in good heart. Stablemates REGAL ROCK (1), who’s first-up, and TREACHEROUSTIMES (4) will both come out hard and be map-dependent, while GOZO MAJOR (3) warrants consideration if he gains a start. BACK: SPEEDY HEALEY (2)– 2.5 units (win) SELECTIONS:SPEEDY HEALEY (2), WAR ZONE (9), FREAK OUT (6), PICKLE IT (8)

OVERVIEW:MISS ADI (3) is third-up and finds her most suitable opposition after clashing with a few handy ones. She comes off a good second last start at Melton, where she found the line strongly in good closing sectionals. The stable is flying this season, striking at 33%, and with one of the best drivers in the business aboard, you can expect a positive drive to find a nice position and prove hard to run down. FANTASY FLIGHT (10) has been a model of consistency and was rewarded with victory last time out at Melton. Albeit in a winnable maiden, she worked in the run and was too good. The draw is a disadvantage and makes her task of working into the race more difficult. BELLA LOUISE (9) goes to the back row but does find an easier grade than what she’s been racing in of late. Her win here came from in front, so whilst this suits, she will still be reliant on tempo. ALL THINGS SPICY (8) is racing well enough to suggest a win isn’t far away, and although she drops in class, she will be driven for luck and has minor claims. SWEET LADY LOU (1) is worth keeping safe from the soft draw, while BEAU BECA (6) will need some luck with the map coming off a win last time at Kilmore, but does have gate speed. BACK: MISS ADI (3)– 2.5 units (win) SELECTIONS:MISS ADI (3), FANTASY FLIGHT (10), BELLA LOUISE (9), ALL THINGS SPICY (8)

OVERVIEW:SPIRITED LASS (7) was the popular elect last Saturday at Melton but galloped in the concluding stages looking all but the winner when trying to find a gap. There’s no question she’s an unreliable type, but when she trots, she displays more ability than the opposition here. With Herbertson aboard and a few more options from the draw than last time she can recapture the form from over a month ago when she was going for three on the trot. STRAIGHT TO THETOP (3) can mix her gate speed it seems which makes her difficult to map, but she does look as though she shouldn’t be too far off the top end over the short trip. She seems to sprint better off a slower tempo. BUSLIN BRODY (2) was racing well last month, but his last couple haven’t been up to the usual standard. The soft draw gives him options and is open to improvement. THATS DUDLEY (4) did a really nice job for the new stable last time out, winning off a long break at Geelong. This is slightly more challenging but is worth keeping safe. Several minor place chances in RIGHT OF REPLY (1), KITTY CASH (6), DEJAY DEX and MAJESTIC CHARMA (9). BACK: SPIRITED LASS (7) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS:SPIRITED LASS (7), STRAIGHT TO THETOP (3), BUSLIN BRODY (2), THATS DUDLEY (4)

OVERVIEW: Without doubt the toughest race of the night with little quality form to go on. ROCKNROLL RAMBO (7) is having his fourth run for the new stable and there have been some positives in those runs to suggest he’s on the improve. The draw is very tricky, but those who will press forward will likely not have much petrol at the finish and he can overcome them. CHASING THE WIND (6) gets Chris Alford aboard now, and although he hasn’t been far away, he hasn’t been a winning factor, so is worth keeping safe. POWERLINC (4) is the stablemate and is slowly improving. She could be obliged to press forward from this draw and wasn’t far away in a similar race two back. He had every chance at Ballarat on Wednesday, but this is a bit easier. Then there’s a very even bunch with minor claims based on luck in running, with REASON TO LAUGH (8) and BLISSFULL LILY (10) going okay but have tough draws. GROOM (5) may be the likely leader but hasn’t won in a while and his form needs to lift. RIVER PATROL (1) will also map ok and has a good driver, and with that set up can improve on what he’s produced lately. SELECTIONS:ROCKNROLL RAMBO (7), POWERLINC (4), CHASING THE WIND (6), RIVER PATROL (1)

OVERVIEW: Tricky race with a mix of ages, 2yo and up, first starters and different form lines. Market moves must be respected. Looking at the first starters, ITSAWOMANSWORLD (4) is a 3yo filly with a whopping seven trials leading into her debut, with the two most recent at Cranbourne in reasonable time. TWIGSTAR (2) is a 2yo filly, and she found the line well at a recent trial at Melton behind a horse who has since franked that form by winning well. She has an astute trainer/driver combination. Of those with exposed form, CHARLIE SEBASTIAN (1) was very good to the line last start at Maryborough, where from a bad draw he was unlucky not to win, albeit in a moderate line-up. He was only moderate away from the same draw at this track two starts back. DIAMOND CHIPP (10) and ALL THINGS MENACING (11) are tied together through a run here at Cranbourne, where they finished second and third respectively. Both have shown some good signs in their careers to date but must overcome tricky draws. I feel one of those will get the job done, but there are plenty of questions. SELECTIONS: CHARLIE SEBASTIAN (1), DIAMOND CHIPP (10), TWIGSTAR (2), ALL THINGS MENACING (11)

OVERVIEW: THE PASO DOBLE (7) broke through for a terrific and deserved maiden victory last time out, showing his customary early gate speed and putting a space on his rivals. Even though he’s drawn wide, his gate manners can negate that, allowing him to look for a forward position and take running down again. MISS KOMMUNICATION (5) is also quick out and will look to slide across. Her past few when racing in slightly harder grade haven’t been flash, but she looks better suited against this opposition. JINXED (3) is a 3yo filly having her first start and she has trialled okay leading into this, although the times haven’t been overly flash. Monitor the betting and keep her safe. CARTACALHA (8) had every hope last time out but was sound to the line in finishing second at Ballarat. She’s yet to win in eight tries as a 3yo, however. FREEMARKS ELITE (2) was okay on debut but was still a fair way off the top pick, while DANCE WITH ROCKY (4) needs to improve, but respect the stable. SELECTIONS: THE PASO DOBLE (7), MISS KOMMUNICATION (5), JINXED (3), CARTACALHA (8)

OVERVIEW:MASTER LOUEY (1) looks a good map bet here with ace driver James Herbertson aboard. He looks to map behind the speed, of which there appears to be plenty, and strips fitter third-up. He was well up in grade from a bad draw last time in the VICBRED, and prior to that fresh he didn’t get clear running in a quality race. Whilst he gives away ratings points, that map and his late closing sectionals may be enough to overcome a quality line-up. BULLETPROOF KID (3) deserves another chance despite going down as a well-supported odds-on favourite at Shepparton. He didn’t get much peace in front there and narrowly went down on the line. His form prior had been excellent, particularly here at his home track where he has bumped into a couple of handy ones. He’s got the speed to lead these, but his chances depend on the pressure thereafter. COVERED IN GOLD (6) has been racing well for the new stable, winning three times this season, including three starts back when they ran good time, setting it up for the swoopers. BINALONG MATE (5) is his stablemate and is also racing in great heart, winning two of his past four. With good speed, I expect both of those to put pressure on BULLETPROOF KID (3), the likely leader. ANGELS WATCHING (4) is the other one with a knockout chance if the others overcook things. It’s not the first time he’s won under those circumstances. SELECTIONS: MASTER LOUEY (1), BULLETPROOF KID (3), COVERED IN GOLD (6), BINALONG MATE (5)

OVERVIEW: A very fast front row here makes for an exciting race over the mile. UBETTA KNOT (7) was very well backed on Tuesday at Shepparton, where she worked forward to find the top and ran along in good time when finishing third. She’s raced up in grade for most of this season, and although the map is a little tricky, this is the most suitable line-up she’s faced in some time. WILD CARD (8) doesn’t get involved in the speed battle and maps quietly on the pegs. He’s coming off an excellent run at Melton, where he led with confidence and stuck on well to finish second. His claim sees him well graded, and he can flash late if the breaks come. SPORTS WRACK (1) hasn’t won in a while, but this draw is favourable, and for the most part he hasn’t had much luck this season, so he can improve. JUST AS WELL (6) is another who will appreciate this company and will also have a look at the top end. He hasn’t produced his best for some time but can be an improver. BACK: UBETTA KNOT (7)– 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:UBETTA KNOT (7), WILD CARD (8), SPORTS WRACK (1), JUST AS WELL (6)

I GOTTA GO (5) hasn't had much luck at his past two starts and gets his chance to return to the winner's circle after numerous handy performances, with this looking a slight drop in class on what he has been contesting. There appears to be enough speed drawn inside for him to be driven with a sit and saved for one run late. SPORT WATCHER (4) was a strong winner last start in handy time after doing some work early and is expected to again push forward from the gate. Her chances may depend on the tactics adopted with the polemarker MY TANYA LEE (1), who has shown good gate speed in the past but resumes after nearly 18 months away from the races. BRIGHTLY BLAZE (2) produced an improved performance against older horses last start after returning from the mainland and draws to secure a nice position on speed with cover, giving her every chance to be in the finish again. SOHO TUXEDO (6) also drops back in grade and gets his chance to return to the podium after showing good promise as a two-year-old. FEELINKINDALUCKY (7) has been consistent in the lower-class races, while CALA SERENA (3) could be the improver if she displays better race manners than what she has shown since arriving in the state. Selections:I GOTTA GO (5), SPORT WATCHER (4), BRIGHTLY BLAZE (2), SOHO TUXEDO (6)

The David Medhurst Memorial brings together an even bunch of horses for the novice drivers. IDEN OLIVER (8) finally had some luck go his way and was super impressive in fast time when getting the money last start, and will be looking to produce a similar performance here. SWEET DIXIE (6) looked the winner before being run down late by the above runner last start and looks testing material again, although she may need to be driven more conservatively with plenty of gate speed drawn inside. RESURGENT WARRIOR (7) is in a similar boat from the wide draw and has been racing well of late. CAN FEEL THE FURY (1) has returned to form in recent starts and gets the plum draw to receive every opportunity. Expect DENNY (4) and SAPPHIRE GAMBLER (5) to press forward from the middle draws in search of prominent positions. DONNY IN PARIS (3) has been racing consistently of late and will no doubt go around at each-way odds again here and should be thereabouts. Selections:IDEN OLIVER (8), SWEET DIXIE (6), CAN FEEL THE FURY (1), RESURGENT WARRIOR (4)

The open-class race of the night brings together a small but competitive field, where we see the return of HORATIUS SPECULO (4). He was super competitive in the features early this season after progressing through his grades in quick succession over the summer, and you'd expect he has returned an even stronger horse this preparation. He has had two trials to prepare for this and, although he may still need the run, his class could prevail. GO THE RED (5) continues to churn out wins for the stable since arriving from Queensland and should be tracking the favourite everywhere he goes in the run, giving him every chance to finish home strongly again. GORDONS BAY (6) may need some genuine tempo throughout to help him finish best late. Expect WATERMELON SUGAR (3) to find the front and dictate terms, and he could run a sneaky race at odds. VANQUISH STRIDE (2) and POWER UP (1) rise slightly in class but should get their chances to be thereabouts from the favourable draws. Selections:HORATIUS SPECULO (4), GO THE RED (5), WATERMELON SUGAR (3), GORDONS BAY (6)

A small but strong field comes together for the two-year-old feature, with numerous promising horses engaged. LOTSEVEN (7) was a strong second in the Sweepstakes feature last start. He draws the outside gate here, so may be relying on some solid tempo throughout to give him the opportunity to run over the top late. HAVEYOUMETMAYNARD (4) looks to have plenty of ability, which was on display when a big-margin winner in June after running along in front by a significant margin throughout and still recording good time. Expect he may have the speed to cross those drawn inside, while STABLE TALK (5) should also push forward from the gate, with little separating the pair in a recent trial run in good time. POGACAR (3) produced some very impressive sectionals when winning easily on debut and should only improve from that performance. He looks likely to secure a nice camp just behind the speed with cover, giving him every chance to be in the finish. OUR ROB ROY (6) hasn't done much wrong in his career to date and will also be hoping for some solid tempo throughout to allow him to finish home strongly. MISS VINCENTINA (1) and SOLO SNITCH (2) continue to improve each time they go around but may lack the class of some of the more favoured runners at this stage. Selections:HAVEYOUMETMAYNARD (4), LOTSEVEN (7), POGACAR (3), STABLE TALK (5)

LITTLE CAPPUCCINA (2) should be first to the pegs here and looks to get every chance to break through. UNOBETTER (9) gets the nice trailing back-row draw, which should push her into a handy position through the middle of the field, and should appreciate stepping up to the middle-distance journey this week. WHERES THE SAVS (8) is never far away and is regularly looming as a winning chance in these races. He will need a little luck from the inside back-row draw but will be dangerous late if the gaps appear. DEMON DESTROYER (11) raced roughly at times last start after a handy trial performance and draws the car park here, but at his best is still capable of winning. The other Langley-trained runners in VOODOO RANGER (4), DIAMONDONTHEROCKS (5) and ARRIVAL TIME (7) all look realistic winning chances with the right runs, although they strike awkward draws. IDEN ELIZA JANE (6) clearly possesses some ability, so it will be interesting to see what tactics are adopted from the wide outside front-row draw. Selections:LITTLE CAPPUCCINA (2), UNOBETTER (9), DEMON DESTROYER (11), WHERES THE SAVS (8)

MIRA DOMINA (1) has been very good at her past two starts over the short mile distance and would only need to hold that form to be going close again here, providing she brings her best behaviour. She should ensure a solid tempo in front, which should suit the back-row runners GOBSMACKED (9) and KENYA (10) from their favourable trailing draws, with the latter really finding his best form over his past few starts. Most runners in this field have been thereabouts of late in races of this nature, while ALBERIO (8) could be the one at odds to improve, getting a nice soft pegs run following the expected favourite. KEAYANG LEXI (2) should again find a nice position on speed with cover and must be included in the exotics. Selections:MIRA DOMINA (1)KENYA (10), GOBSMACKED (9), ALBERIO (8)

SHADES OF SILK (3) produced a tough effort when third in quick time last start after doing all the work outside the leader throughout. Expect him to again push hard forward here, although his chances could depend on the tactics of those drawn inside him, who, despite being somewhat out of form, possess handy gate speed if they decide to kick up early. SHOOBEES SPIRIT (5) broke through for a deserved victory last start and should again be driven quietly, hoping for a strong tempo throughout to allow him to finish home strongly. ART HUNTSMAN (9) is chasing three straight victories, although he may not receive quite the same run this time, you can't knock a horse in form and he again looks a strong winning chance. LAID BACK (10) should be following his every move and is certainly due to break through, having loomed as the winner on several occasions of late without quite putting his nose in front where it counts. Selections:SHADES OF SILK (3), LAID BACK (10), ART HUNTSMAN (9), SHOOBEES SPIRIT (5)

The low-class race of the night, where this field is somewhat hard to assess. AWAY GAME (2) has the gate speed to find the front but has been out of form for some time now, while ALBY PRIDDY (3) may get the perfect one-one position if BARBETTE (4) pushes forward and gives him cover as expected. He is backing up after an average performance last start but had been very consistent prior to that. QUEENOFDANCE (9) is always a chance of bobbing up at odds in races of this nature, while DEBT TILL WE PART (10) and NO NUKES SKIPPER (11) will again be relying on some genuine tempo throughout to allow them to finish home strongly. It wouldn't surprise to see any runner in this field bob up and win, including KUHIO CREST (5) if he can recapture his best form first up in the state, while ROSE NOIRE (7) also has claims despite the outside front-row draw. Selections:ALBY PRIDDY (3), BARBETTE (4), DEBT TILL WE PART (10), KUHIO CREST (5)

EVERYTHING BUT THE (1) ran them along at a solid clip throughout when winning last start and was simply too strong late. Expect he may attempt similar tactics again here. GOODTIME OSCAR (2) has been super consistent for some time now and gets a nice front-row draw to find a position on speed, making him the clear danger. SMOOTH REASON (3) at her best could easily win a race like this but has been somewhat inconsistent of late. MISTA EAGLE (8) and WE SALUTE YOU (9) look to find their preferred position along the pegs and will be hoping the gaps appear as they turn for home. TOLD YOU TWICE (4) and HAMMER DAN (5) have both been thereabouts of late but will need nice runs in transit to be in the finish from their awkward front-row draws. Selections:EVERYTHING BUT THE (1), GOODTIME OSCAR (2), WE SALUTE YOU (9), SMOOTH REASON (3) Harness.org.au Help Privacy Advertise Terms Of Use Contact Us © Racing Information Services Enterprise 2026 Powered by

OVERVIEW:DIAMOND ECLIPSE (3) will no doubt have a look at the lead, being a speedy type off the arm with James Herbertson aboard. He’s also dropping back from tougher company and difficult draws at Melton, including racing in FFA company last time out. He looks well placed under this ratings scale and is open to sharp improvement. TELEMACHUS (1) drops back to provincial grade after racing in strong company at Melton, and the last time he did that he was a winner at Ballarat in July, when able to lead all the way from the same draw. He’s a horse who’s been in the Black Book for quite some time, but often strikes a difficult field, map or luck in running. He does again face some handy types, but he should get his chance late to bounce back to winning form. HOT DEAL (5) is clearly the best-rated horse in the event, almost double much of the opposition on the class scale. His map looks a little sticky in terms of finding cover, but he must be respected. THESTATESMAN (9) is the knockout horse should those off the front row overcook things. Whilst he’s commonly viewed as being at his best in front, sectionally he can come home strongly with the right tempo. HELLOVATIME (2) has a soft draw but is up in class, while AMPHIJET (4) will come out hard and be map-dependent, but both have minor claims. BACK: DIAMOND ECLIPSE (3)– 2.5 units (win) SELECTIONS:DIAMOND ECLIPSE (3); TELEMACHUS (1), HOT DEAL (5), THESTATESMAN (9)

OVERVIEW:SPORTING RAGE (4) is racing in terrific form of late and his chances are always improved by the opportunity to show his gate speed. He will be stamped urgent here to look for the lead and is coming off a career-peak mile rate, albeit from behind the leader where he had every chance. The distance is in his favour to go all the way, and he is a winner at this track. OWEN THE SAINTS (1) gets a draw that could see him use enough speed to potentially map behind the leader here. His best performances come when mapping close with cover, as evidenced by his win back in June. He’s open to sharp improvement and is a strong winning chance if the top pick is vulnerable late. MISTER JIMARINGLE (8) was a winner in this grade three runs back and has just found things a bit rich his past couple. The soft draw will help him be strong late if they go too hard. AMERICAN GUY (2) is racing better than his form may suggest, maps softly and has minor claims, as do HELLAVASTORY (3) and LEONARD (5) if the map and tempo work out. BACK: SPORTING RAGE (4)– 2.5 units (win) SELECTIONS:SPORTING RAGE (4), OWEN THE SAINTS (1), MISTER JIMARINGLE (8), AMERICAN GUY (2)

OVERVIEW:ALTA BAYAMO (9) returned to winning form last start when able to lead and ran very good time for this grade. Although he gets a different set-up now, those sectionals are hard to ignore against this opposition, and with Herbertson committing again, it only adds further confidence. MEGAWATTS (3) could be open to sharp improvement here, drawing more favourably over the middle trip to race in a better position than what she’s been accustomed to of late. She was a winner here in July when able to race handy over this same distance and beat arguably a stronger field than she meets here. She could represent nice value on an each-way basis. THEROUX (5) has enjoyed a good season, racing largely in concession races. He’s often a difficult horse to map, but when Alford has been aboard in recent times, he’s gained plenty of market attention, and he’s a strong chance. IAMAWINGATE (2) looks to get a comfortable lead from the soft draw, but whether he holds or takes cover is the question. His best form does come in weaker grade, but Herbertson is a plus and he will no doubt be popular in the market. OVER THE LINE (7) is racing well but has a tricky draw and is up in grade. BACK: ALTA BAYAMO (9)– 2 units (win) SELECTIONS:ALTA BAYAMO (9), MEGAWATTS (3), THEROUX (5), IAMAWINGATE (2)

OVERVIEW:WICKED MITZI (4) is yet to win in nine attempts this season, but in her defence, she’s often had tricky draws and set-ups to overcome. She now has a favourable draw to use her gate speed and look for the top end over the short trip, which she loves. Her only try at this track was good behind a smart one when they ran time, and this looks much more suitable. KIA ORA BEAUTY (8) was a winner when able to lead from the pole three starts back, but the back row doesn’t help here. Although she can be a little hard to catch, Herbertson goes back aboard, and the last time that happened she was a winner at Shepparton. KATUNGA EXPRESS (7) is another who always seems to draw poorly but often tends to be map-negative regardless. He comes off a good second last start at Melton, where he sat parked and they ran quick time. He’s a solid chance once again. SCOOTER LOU (5) is a last-start winner at Melton but had all the favours there from the inside draw and was able to outsprint them late. That’s good form for this, but the map is a bit sticky. KING KASEY (1) is up in grade, but the favourable draw should ensure a positive map and give her every chance to be in the mix. BACK: WICKED MITZI (4)– 1.5 units (win) SELECTIONS:WICKED MITZI (4), KIA ORA BEAUTY (8), KATUNGA EXPRESS (7), SCOOTER LOU (5)

OVERVIEW: Tricky race with a mix of ages, 2yo and up, first starters, different form lines and some bad-mannered types. GREAT HORIZON (4) goes on top, if for no other reason than she is the most reliable trotter in the race. She’s clean-gaited and shows good early gate speed to get the right map here. Her recent runs have been okay, placing four times from eight starts this season, and she could potentially be the last one standing based on exposed form. PARDRAY (6) is a 3yo filly who has shown positive glimpses of form, but she’s also shown bad manners, as she did last time, so tread warily. You get the “Herb Factor” here, which is a major advantage in these races where the form can’t always be relied upon. GLOBAL ELITE (3) is a 3yo filly having her second start after a solid debut at Kilmore, where she finished second. This class looks suitable for her to go one better. SOLO SAPPHIRE (2) ran second three starts back and was unlucky not to take the race out after being held up at a vital stage. Her last couple, whilst beaten a long way, were in much tougher grade. WHOSHOTTHEPIEMAN (1) is a 3yo gelding who is second-up from a break after getting it wrong under standing-start conditions last time out. He didn’t trot that well throughout, but that was only his second outing for the new stable and he did have market support. BROTHER THOMAS (7) is the only 2yo in the race but does have an SP profile that suggests he’s better than his exposed form. SELECTIONS: GREAT HORIZON (4), PARDRAY (6), GLOBAL ELITE (3), SOLO SAPPHIRE (2)

OVERVIEW: AMADA VILLMA (2) will find this much more suitable than her last outing, where she struck a strong line-up and they ran time while she was forced to sit parked. This is her best draw in some time to press forward and potentially find a more comfortable lead over the short trip. There doesn’t look to be much pressure, which may allow her to pinch a quarter and be hard to run down. HIGHVIEW HAMMER (6) has very good gate speed and normally likes to hand over for cover, so may map perfectly behind the top pick after a retake move. He will get his chance late if that map eventuates. ESPERANZA (1) is a last-start winner at Kilmore, where she mapped perfectly and was able to overcome them in a slow mile rate. She has claims again from the soft draw. CRESCO THREEPEAT (7) has been performing well of late, finding the right tempo in his races, as he’s a tough type who grinds into his finish. WHERES WOOD WOOD (3) and MAJOR MAURIE (5) have sticky draws but have minor place claims. SELECTIONS: AMADA VILLMA (2), HIGHVIEW HAMMER (6), ESPERANZA (1), CRESCO THREEPEAT (7)

OVERVIEW:SKADI (2) looks a good map bet here with ace driver James Herbertson aboard. She looks well drawn with the mare’s allowance and should map behind the speed. She’s had one trial leading into this, so her fitness levels should be sound, and the likely moderate closing fractions will give her a strong chance along the passing lane. MYNAMEISRUBY (3) deserves another chance despite going down as a well-supported favourite at Shepparton. She had to work a little too hard early there, but her form prior had been sound, and she does seem to have a liking for this track. OHHEMJAY CRESCO (4) was well supported into odds-on last time out and was fair to the line, although under pressure a long way out. He’s worth another chance in this line-up. ROCKIN CHARMER (1) is first-up from a break off two fair trials. He was quite good last preparation for the stable, and from the soft draw has claims, at least for the minor end. BACK: SKADI (2)– 1.5 units (win) SELECTIONS: SKADI (2), MYNAMEISRUBY (3), OHHEMJAY CRESCO (4), ROCKIN CHARMER (1)

OVERVIEW: BETSY ANNE (3) reunites with Herbertson, which is a key booking considering his strike rate on the mare. He’s not missed a place in his last four drives on her, and has either won or gone close when she has been able to lead, which I fancy she can do here. She’s open to sharp improvement on what she’s produced lately. CONNIES PRESIDENT (5) raced against the pacers last time, so it was no surprise to see the beaten margin there, but his form prior saw him finish in the money in five straight runs, including two wins. He has gate speed and will be looking to map positively. THE CHOOK (6) has run some good races this preparation but remains winless. On her effort three starts back she’s a strong chance here, but she needs to lift on her last couple. WALKIN UNDERSTARZ (7) has placed four times from nine starts this season, but is expected to map negatively here, so will be dependent on the right tempo to genuinely threaten. SELECTIONS:BETSY ANNE (3), CONNIES PRESIDENT (5), THE CHOOK (6), WALKIN UNDERSTARZ (7)

HEZ SO ROYAL (4) was a winner two starts ago when he defeated ALWAYSBEALADY by a head. Once again he faces a tough assignment tonight but he is a strong performer and is worth strong consideration. REPELLING (2) has his first South Australian start for Samantha Hill. His Victorian record is strong and he has plenty of gate speed. He is a bit threat tonight. IM ALL BUSINESS (6) is a big threat as well after winning last start. NAROBI (1) is also a chance.

LOCHINVAR LEADER (7) ran second last start after being run down by VATICAN GREEN but he had won his last four starts before that. He has had a few weeks off and the rest should do him some good. He will be hard to beat. VATICAN GREEN (10) finds a race and a draw he can win from. He will be storming home late if he is anywhere near his best. KYORETSU (1) and NITEONTHETOWN (5) are also chances.

KEAYANG MEMORY (6) has won three of her last five starts. She has put together some really good runs recently. She should be storming home late. CHILDERS ROAD (4) is well drawn and he always run well for Ryan Hryhorec. He is worth consideration. NEDS BEACH (10) and PARISIAN BANDIT (9) are also chances.

NEVADA GAMBLER (6) has won four of his last five starts leading. He may find it hard to lead tonight but his recent form is very impressive. CLARENDEN TRIBUTE (1) hasn’t won a race for 13 months but he will be a strong chance from gate one. THE GOLDEN HOOK (4) and FLYIN TOMMY (8) are also chances.

THE VICARS GIRL (10) has won seven out of her last eight start. She was very disappointing last start but she is good enough to recover from that run and shake up this race. CARLA PIXIE (9) has been running around the mark at Melton. Tonight will be a challenge but it’s hard to ignore her recent form. FEEL THE MOMENT (2) and DAISY BOUCHEA (6) are also chances.

MY ULTIMATE HENRY (7) was a winner at Mildura two starts back. He is the only runner in this race to break his maiden. The draw will be tricky but he should be hard to beat. WISHFUL DESIRE (4) looks like a big danger after going roughly but recovering well. NO GOOD REASON (2) and SIENNA BELLA (3) are also chances.

KYVALLEY JAGGER (5) finds an easier race compared to what he has been racing against in Victoria. If he can bring his best run then he is a strong chance. TINEY (1), STAR OF PATRICK (8) and LOW LIE THE FIELDS (6) are all chances.

LUCKY BAMBINO (3) has won his last two starts and was impressive here on Tuesday night winning by 4 meters. LOWER MANHATTAN (2), LONESTAR WARRIOR (4) and TUFFASNAILS (1) are also chances. FEARFULL DRAGON (5) was a major improver last start when he defeated IMA TIGGY TIGER by 37.4 meters and ran a mile rate of 1.57.6. A repeat of that run will make him extremely hard to beat. PARISIAN BANDIT (6) looks like the main danger and is racing around the mark without winning. BROBENAH GIRL (2) and LARDY DAH LADY (3) look the next best.

STAR OF WILLOUGHBY (6) returned to the winners list last start when he defeated CHILDERS ROAD by 10.4 meters. He is a major chance again today against this field but he does lack consistency. HUGH GO (7), MALACHITE ROCK (2) and GOLDEN JAYLET (3) are also chances.

THE REGINATOR (2) finds a much easier race tonight compared to what he has been up against. He is well drawn and he looks like a big threat today. SPLASH OF PAYNT (1) is well drawn and joins the Ingrid Smith stable. He is worth consideration and he has raced well here in the past. PARADIGM (8) and A MAJOR STARR (5) are also chances.

QUARTARARO (10) is one of the better horses in this race when he trots smoothly. If he can trot smoothy and work into the race at the right time then he will be hard to beat again tonight after winning three of his last four. JAKEE BOY (5) looks like a big threat after a handy win in a small field last start. GOLDEN SKIES (3) and TINEY (9) are also chances.

LORD VERDE (8) has not won a race since March but he is better than what he has been showing. He finds a much easier race today and he should get a quiet run into the race. He is definitely a strong each way chance. SEASIDE LADY (7), MEET ME AT THE BEACH (6) and ORAMA (4) are also chances.

WHENIMREADY (5) ran a nice race in his first South Australian start behind ONE MILLIE. He was only beaten by 4.6 meters and he looks like a threat today. LUNADIVA (3) ran a better race last start behind B T CAPTIVATE. She is a major threat today as well. BLINGADINGDING (6) and JUST BECCY (7) are also chances. OVERVIEW:ANTONOV (7) commences from the tough handicap of 20m but he boasts a very consistent record from the standing start and he sustained a strong run to win under similar conditions at Maryborough last outing. He has plenty of time to overcome the handicap over the race distance of 2690m and the small field will assist so he should prove hard to beat. FREMARKSPEGGY (1) appeared to have every chance when second behind ANTONOV (7) the last time they met but she is a good chance of ending up being behind the leader again so she is worth an investment. DISTANT SUN (2) has only been placed once in four standing start appearances but his form from the mobile start is strong so he is a winning chance if he gets away safely. EL CONQUEROR (3) began well and progressed forward to find the lead when third behind ANTONOV (7) last outing. He is likely to be driven in a similar manner and is worth a ticket each way. SELECTIONS: ANTONOV (7), FREMARKSPEGGY (1), DISTANT SUN (2), EL CONQUEROR (3)

OVERVIEW:ASMILEANDAWINX (5) began quickly from the outside of the front line and parked on the outside of the leader throughout when a big winner in a mile rate of 1.55.1 at Maryborough last outing. She is meeting a field of similar quality and should prove hard to beat again. JILLIBY ILLUSION (6) won comfortably at Bendigo two starts ago then followed with a fourth at Wagga, where she finished well from a rearward position via the sprint lane. She is a handy mare and should be finishing off strongly again. WE FAVOUR ROSIE (3) was held up for a run at a vital stage and finished solidly for a close second behind Grinning Beach Boy last outing. She is racing in good form and looms as one of the leading chances. STARZINHEREYES (7) has been unplaced in three starts since returning from Queensland but she recorded a slick mile rate of 1.54.2 when she won at Albion Park prior so she is worth another chance. BACK: ASMILEANDAWINX (5) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: ASMILEANDAWINX (5), JILLIBY ILLUSION (6), WE FAVOUR ROSIE (3), STARZINHEREYES (7)

OVERVIEW: DARETODANCE (7) returns to trainer Gerard Jamieson after a long stint in Queensland. She led throughout and won easily at Redcliffe last outing and she dashed home in a slick final quarter of 27.5 seconds to win a Maryborough trial recently so she is likely to be strongly fancied. SOHO AMARYLLIS (6) never appeared to be comfortable and eventually broke stride when unplaced at her first run since June. Her form last preparation was strong and she is worth another chance. AMERICAN MICHI (1) will appreciate a drop back in class for this assignment and he was picking up some ground in the latter stages despite finishing seventh at Ballarat last outing. He is much better drawn for this assignment and is capable of improving on his numerical form. THE SPARKLER (4) is a lightly raced gelding that is showing promise. He found a heat of the Super Series to be too rich for him at only his fourth attempt last week but his first three efforts were sound and he will find this race to be more suitable. BACK: DARETODANCE (7) – 1 unit (each way) SELECTIONS: DARETODANCE (7), SOHO AMARYLLIS (6), AMERICAN MICHI (1), THE SPARKLER (4)

OVERVIEW: EASTBRO MIKA (4) settled three back on the inside, was held up for a run at a vital stage and made ground via the sprint lane when a handy third at Terang last outing. She is worth thought under these conditions. KIMCHI (5) settled in a rearward position, came out three horses wide at the 700m and battled on fairly for fifth at Ballarat. He tends to perform best when he is close to the pace and he should be competitive from his reasonable draw. HAVADASH JOH (1) is a fast beginner and attempted to lead throughout when third at Hamilton on August 10. He finished off nicely for fourth at Terang last outing and is worth an investment from the pole position. MISS PIGGY WIGGY (8) has the perfect trailing draw and her recent form has been consistent so she is worth a ticket each way. SELECTIONS: EASTBRO MIKA (4), KIMCHI (5), HAVADASH JOH (1), MISS PIGGY WIGGY (8)

OVERVIEW:LORD LOGAN (6) raced without cover throughout at his first two victories at Melton and Geelong then met a strong field at his latest Melton fourth, where he led and switched into a pace under pressure over the final stages. He is a promising trotter and appears to be the class runner of the field. LIFE ON THE HILL (3) was a winner at Bendigo in early July and was placed behind Scar in a stronger race three starts ago so he should be competitive under these conditions. NEDZA THRILLER (2) tends to perform best when he can lead out then take cover so he is perfectly drawn to suit his racing pattern. He commenced from the inside of the second line and was shuffled back on the markers mid-race at his latest sixth. I AM HARRO (8) finished off strongly from midfield when second behind Against The Bridle in a slick mile rate of 1.58.1 last outing and is not without a chance. BACK: LORD LOGAN (6) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS: LORD LOGAN (6), LIFE ON THE HILL (3), NEDZA THRILLER (2), I AM HARRO (8)

OVERVIEW:JANSEN (1) is resuming since June and hasn’t been to the trials but he was showing enough promise at the end of his last campaign and is drawn to receive the perfect trip. ASHANTE WARRIOR (11) broke stride at the start, settled a clear last early and angled out very wide on the home turn when an unlucky seventh at Wagga last outing. He would have just about won had he not made an error last time and is worth thought here. BETTING ATTACK (2) attempted to lead early, was left stranded on the outside of the leader and raced very fiercely so he had excuses at his latest fifth. He is a good chance of finding the lead now and is racing well enough to figure in the finish. CALIFORNIA COOL (8) is a first starter for trainer Tim McGuigan that has been placed in all of his three trial performances at Bacchus Marsh and must be kept safe. MAHEO (9) was placed in a handy mile rate of 1.58.1 at her debut then was in a striking position but broke stride when trying to push into the clear at her latest ninth. She follows out behind the likely leader and is worth a ticket each way. If the reserve ROCKAMARA (4) gains a start, he will prove hard to beat on his latest trial second in a mile rate of 1.56.4. SELECTIONS: JANSEN (1), ASHANTE WARRIOR (11), BETTING ATTACK (2), CALIFORNIA COOL (8)

OVERVIEW: MAORI TATTOO (8) was resuming since May when fourth at Cranbourne then ran a sharper race at his latest second behind Joe Lou. He follows out behind a fast beginner and should prove hard to beat. CHARLIE WALKER (2) began quickly to find the lead and was always in control at Ballarat on Wednesday night. He is drawn to find the lead again and should take catching. CHINSKI (4) hasn’t raced since a seventh at Maryborough in October but he will be fitter after a recent trial third at Bacchus Marsh and has the early speed to be prominent throughout. KYVALLEY MISTY (11) began quickly from the standing start to find the lead and was run down late when third behind Jakarta last outing. She is racing well and is worth thought along with ITGETSBETTER (10). SELECTIONS: MAORI TATTOO (8), CHARLIE WALKER (2), CHINSKI (4), KYVALLEY MISTY (11)

OVERVIEW: BOUTIKA (9) produced a career best performance when she sprinted brilliantly off a nice trail and broke the track record at Ararat last outing. She is meeting a field of similar quality and is clearly the horse to beat again. SILENT REVERIE (5) is a fast beginner and is a good chance of finding the lead. She led out then took cover when third behind Champagnes at Ballarat last outing and won from behind the leader on that track three starts ago. BROOKLYNGOTCOURAGE (3) has been runner up several times recently and missed out narrowly behind Love Who on August 06 so she is a place chance again. QUEEN TRUSCOTT (10) was caught wide early, restrained to a rearward position and couldn’t recover when an unlucky seventh at Maryborough last outing. She led throughout to win at Shepparton prior and is a place chance under these conditions. BACK: BOUTIKA (9) - 3 units (win) SELECTIONS: BOUTIKA (9), SILENT REVERIE (5), BROOKLYNGOTCOURAGE (3), QUEEN TRUSCOTT (10)

OVERVIEW: HUXHAM CHUBB (6) began quickly to find the lead and attempted to lead throughout when third behind Delightful Miki in The Pearl at Melton last outing. This race is easier and she should give a bold showing. EASTBRO KOZZY (10) was caught behind tiring horses then finished off strongly when an unlucky second last outing. He is poorly drawn but warrants respect. JANIEBQUICK (5) recorded a slick mile rate of 1.56.3 when she won at Melton four starts ago then competed at Metropolitan level at her next three attempts. She is racing in good form and looms as one of the leading chances. BREATHE EASY (8) competed at Metropolitan level when eighth at Melton last outing. His form prior was sound and he is likely to find this assignment to be more suitable. MILOLA ROCK (4) has done well in three starts since coming from New South Wales and should be finishing off strongly. She finished hard from midfield to win at Maryborough two starts ago then had little luck in the home straight and should have finished closer at Charlton. SELECTIONS: HUXHAM CHUBB (6), EASTBRO KOZZY (10), JANIEBQUICK (5), BREATHE EASY (8)

OVERVIEW: What a race to start the night of the Vicbred Super Series semi-finals! Good luck guessing the speed map here because there are so many scenarios, with a host of the big guns drawn on the front row. Regardless of where he ends up, I’m siding with the unbeaten ENJOY LIFE (6). He’s eight from eight to start his career, with his most recent win being a strong VSS heat victory at Kilmore from midfield in the running line. MOST EXCITING (1) lands the coveted gate one and will get a much easier trip than he did when a brave fourth in his qualifier behind The Niteshift. He did plenty of work there and was only beaten 12.9m. SOHO CHARMER (2) sat parked for the last lap and dug deep to hold out his rivals to score narrowly in another of the heats. He looms as a big chance if he can cross to the fence, while MAJOR BLITZ (3) takes plenty of encouragement in his races, but was good when he led and almost held out Le Cardinal in a very good qualifying run last week. There are a few other hopes, including another heat winner in CARDIGAN DAN (13), who would need luck from outside the back row but is very talented. SELECTIONS: ENJOY LIFE (6), MOST EXCITING (1), SOHO CHARMER (2), MAJOR BLITZ (3)

OVERVIEW: Semi-final two for the three-year-old colts and geldings, where, like race one, plenty have a chance. There are good wraps on THE NITESHIFT (5), and he showed why with a dominant front-running win in his heat at Kilmore last week. He worked across THIS IS HEAVEN (1) to lead and took out the quickest of the six encounters by 8.3m. If he works to the top again, he will be awfully hard to stop. NEPTUNITE (2) ran a really good race for second in the qualifier behind Soho Charmer and draws the front row this time, reigning Vicbred two-year-old champion SOHO TRUMP (6) found the top in his heat and was too strong for stablemate SOHO PARK AVENUE (8), who was parked and did a great job to box on and finish just 1.8m away. Other key chances are THIS IS HEAVEN (1) from the good draw, DUSTY PHILTRA (4), who was super when running a fast-finishing third to Enjoy Life, and heat winner LE CARDINAL (7), who is very talented but needs the speed on to be a factor from the horror draw. SELECTIONS: THE NITESHIFT (5), NEPTUNITE (2), SOHO TRUMP (6), SOHO PARK AVENUE (8)

OVERVIEW: Craig Turnbull has three runners in this 0W/15.0K stake contest and I’m keen on the chances of ROCKY ROCKS (2) for his daughter Abbey. He ran a really good race for fifth in a heat of the Vicbred Super Series last week when he came from back in the field and made up ground in a pegs-dominated event. Before that, he was narrowly beaten by the undefeated Enjoy Life in the Tasmania Derby at the end of a strong Apple Isle campaign. He draws to get down to the pegs here and looks a great hope. Stablemate HITCH TO HIS STAR (4) did well to finish second in a 1200m dash from a horror gate last time out and is another very talented pacer that is certainly capable of winning a race like this, LOUGLE (7) is knocking on the door for victory since joining the Stephen Clarke barn and came from last to just miss the airborne The Naked Art last weekend, while KEAYANG PAYTON (8) draws inside back row and comes here after a tough death seat triumph at Ballarat. BACK: ROCKY ROCKS (2) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: ROCKY ROCKS (2), HITCH TO HIS STAR (4), LOUGLE (7), KEAYANG PAYTON (8)

OVERVIEW: BETTOR BEACH (12) was scintillating when leading effortlessly and darting clear late to win her three-year-old fillies’ heat by a big space at Kilmore. It was clearly, in my mind, the best victory from the three qualifiers and has her as the horse to beat here. Sure, gate 12 isn’t easy, but she’s good enough to overcome it. Stablemate PRE EMINANT (4) was first-up since running second in the Vicbred final as a two-year-old when she got home nicely for second from three back the fence in the same heat. She draws to press forward and is a classy filly who might get the advantage on BETTOR BEACH (12) from the top. MAGELLAN (1) hit the line well from a hopeless position in the BETTOR BEACH (12) heat and draws well in gate one, while CYCLONE JENNI (7) ripped out the best last half and quarter of her race when she absolutely rattled from last to be beaten just 1.8m by HEAVENLY FLYER (2) in the second of the heats. Others to factor in are Emma Stewart runner MY BETTOR HALF (13), Rickie Alchin’s CONCILIATE (10) and qualifier winner ALOT LIKE JEANNIE (5). BACK: PRE EMINANT (4) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: PRE EMINANT (4), BETTOR BEACH (12), MAGELLAN (1), CYCLONE JENNI (7)

OVERVIEW: Semi-final two for the three-year-old fillies where QUATRO MOTH (5) is set to start a short favourite despite her below-expectations performance in the heat at Kilmore. There, she ran a $1.20 elect, found the front and kicked clear into the straight, only to be run down late and fall into third. She has actually been beaten her last three starts when deep in the odds-on range and can get a little rough under pressure, so is certainly a risk. That said, I’ll back the Emma Stewart stable to get her right, and at her best she’s the horse to beat. SWEET IRISH LOCH (3) ran well enough for fifth in her heat behind Alot Like Jeannie and was a close-up third behind a couple of handy Stewart stablemates at Melton prior to that. She will likely press forward and is a chance of finding the early lead. KEAYANG PASSION (7) was third in the heats to Bettor Beach in a fast last half, and despite being drawn awkward, is a classy enough type who finished fourth in a Group 1 NSW Oaks during May, while TRYX VIXEN (2) is one that I think can improve sharply at odds if she can cross to the fence and get a nice run in transit. ISTHISTHEREALLIFE (12), ENOLA (13) and RACHELS LEGACY (6) all ran well in their respective qualifiers, but have tough gates. SELECTIONS: QUATRO MOTH (5), SWEET IRISH LOCH (3), KEAYANG PASSION (7), TRYX VIXEN (2)

OVERVIEW: SOHO BELLAGIO (4) was a huge winner at Menangle on debut and then had little chance in his Vicbred Super Series heat for two-year-old colts and geldings the way the race was run. He still did a great job to come off the fence for the last lap, close the margin to 9.3m on Some High and record the fastest last half despite covering extra ground. You’d anticipate the aggressive driving style of Michael Stanley would get him to the front here, and from there he’d be the one to beat. LAKE COMO (10) is a very promising gelding from the Jess Tubbs stable who came three-wide in the final half and only went down 4.7m when running second to Cardigan Sniper in the last of three heats last Friday. He’s a danger with the right tempo. FULLY RECKLESS (6) led, handed up and was dragged out of proceedings by a tiring horse in his qualifier behind front-running winner SMACK BANG BART (7), but made up ground when clear and can turn the tables on that rival with a bit of luck. The other key hopes are AUSTON (9) and THEMIDNIGHTEXPRESS (3), but loom more as place chances for mine. BACK: SOHO BELLAGIO (4) – 3 units (win) SELECTIONS: SOHO BELLAGIO (4), LAKE COMO (10), FULLY RECKLESS (6), SMACK BANG BART (7)

OVERVIEW: Semi-final two of the two-year-old boys’ series will see CARDIGAN SNIPER (1) a warm favourite. And it’s deservedly so. He won the $100,000 APG final and $20,000 Youthful Stakes before finding the top and being too strong in his VSS heat last Friday. He draws well, looks to have enough speed to lead and from there will take an awful lot of beating. KINGS GALLERY (9) was perhaps a little disappointing when fourth in his heat behind SOME HIGH (11), but can be forgiven one plain run. He won his two starts prior in good style, chased home Emma Stewart-trained rivals for second in the four outings before that and is a classy type. From the nice trailing draw, he can be a factor. SOME HIGH (11) worked to the top and never looked like being beaten when winning his heat. Barrier 11 isn’t as easy, but he has barely put a foot wrong in five career starts. They look the winning contenders, with FARROH JOE (5) perhaps the best of the rest after his encouraging second placing behind Smack Bang Bart last Friday. ALLOA (2) and BAYSTYLE (3) are other leading place chances. SELECTIONS: CARDIGAN SNIPER (1), KINGS GALLERY (9), SOME HIGH (11), FARROH JOE (5)

OVERVIEW: KAHULA (6) looks to have a mortgage on the first semi-final for the two-year-old fillies after an effortless and dominant heat win last Friday. She worked to the front, controlled the race and darted clear in slick sectionals to win by 5.8m. Her form lines are outstanding, and include a dominant victory in the $200,000 Nutrien series final in May and a great third, beaten just a head, in the Group 1 Protostar at Albion Park in July. She’s the one to beat here. Group 1 placegetter LATHER ME UP (3) finished last in that aforementioned qualifier but did actually record the quickest final half and can improve drawn better this time around, LA CANTATRICE (11) finished best to win a frantic opening qualifier of the series to make it three victories in succession, while SOHO SPARKLE (4) was fair when third to Ideal Frankie in heat two and is among the other contenders along with fast-starter OZZIE TART (5), who only appear place chances if the favourite brings her A game. SELECTIONS: KAHULA (6), LATHER ME UP (3), LA CANTATRICE (11), SOHO SPARKLE (4)

OVERVIEW: IDEAL FRANKIE (5) stamped herself as a star of her age group with massive 21.8m, 46.9m and 42.6m wins in her first three race starts, which included victory in the rich APG series at Melton in late June. That earned her a place in the Group 1 Protostar slot race at Albion Park, where she ultimately failed and finished towards the back of the field. She led and thrashed her rivals as a $1.20 favourite in a heat of this series last week and looks the likely winner once again. SOHO ASTER (3) was caught in a slick lead time in her qualifier, but loomed to win and only missed in a photo. She is a threat with the right trip, particularly if she can get to the fence. SHES CAPTIVATING (6) reeled off the best last half to grab second on debut behind IDEAL FRANKIE (5) and looks to have some really good ability, while TEERDEE (9) and DREAMS FOREVER (7) were two of the eye-catching closers in that frantic heat won by La Cantatrice and are worth considering for trifectas and First 4s. SELECTIONS: IDEAL FRANKIE (5), SOHO ASTER (3), SHES CAPTIVATING (6), TEERDEE (9)

OVERVIEW: Very keen on the chances here of LOCKSLEY CAVALIER (3), who presents first-up from a freshen without a trial. In his one run last campaign, he did an incredible job to finish third from last in a race where first and second across the line were the leader and leader’s back. He was beaten less than 10m in a Group 1 Vicbred Super Series final before that and I think he has the scope to go onto bigger and better things. VICI BLOOM (5) looms as the key danger based off her good trials and dominant first-up win from the front at Melton on August 15. She’s a talent and will be hard to beat, particularly if she gets to the top. FREIGHT SHAKER (1) is an honest type who draws well in gate one, while NAKEDTRUTH (7) dropped out badly with an issue last time but has been back to the trials and defeated Group 1 winner Gatesys Gem in good style there recently. ULE HOOF OIL PACE SOUTH SEAS ROCK (2) has been tackling stronger company and there was plenty to like about latest effort when he came from this barrier for third behind topliner Captains Knock. He'll enjoy the class drop and should get the favours from this draw. NO NOTTHEBUTTONS (6) broke early so did well to recover and place last week, finishing less than 2m off the winner. He draws a couple of spots lower and has won both previous attempts at this longer distance. DANCE WITH CARMER (3) hasn't raced since he placed at Listed level here in June but he has won fresh before and should be ready to go off a trial win. CATCHAFIRE (5) is unbeaten second-up so can progress off his resuming effort when only 3.4m off the winner.

BESTINBEDS.COM.AU PACE I GOT CHILLS (3) continued his good form when he led from this barrier and kept going for a 1.3m win in the August Gift Final at this circuit and distance last start. Should push forward again so may prove tough to catch. OUR SUNSET DELIGHT (8) will have to overcome a wide barrier but he is racing well at this circuit and distance, winning two back before clocking in second last week. Should make an impact again. VAN BASTEN (4) is racing well having placed in both outings since a win here, the latest coming in a higher-graded event. GO WITHOUT (5) drew wider and worked last start so was far from disgraced. Better served by this barrier. SWEET STRIKE (9) draws out but there was merit in last week's placing.

CLUB MENANGLE WARATAH FINAL Very open race. PENURIOUS (3) put the writing on the wall when he placed two back before digging deep to score at Newcastle last time. Another good draw gives him the chance to deliver again. ALABAMA LIONESS (7) made it three wins from her last four outings when she led and fought well at Wagga last week. Draws wider but she has the speed to offset that. ROCKNROLL ROCKET (1) got within a head of Penurious last start, his third placing in four outings since a Newcastle win. Draws to be competitive again. Hard to knock the consistency of LEXY LONGSTOCKINGS (5) who added to a series of top-three results when she missed narrowly at Bathurst last start. Respect along with ULTIMATE EQUUS (11) who draws wide but has put three wins together.

ULTRA AIR PACE VITE MONET (4) has been tackling stronger opposition and wasn't too far off the placegetters last week. Came from this barrier to score at this circuit and distance the last time he raced in this grade so is better placed. ROCKNROLL HAMMER (6) is back in winning form, coming from a similar draw to score here last time. Won the only time he attempted this longer distance so could go on with it. RAGING WHITEBAIT (3) led from a similar draw when she scored here last month and was only 3.2m off the winner in this grade last week. DOUBLE FEAR (7) wasn't too far away from a similar draw last week and owns a solid record at this longer distance.

HARNESS THE EXCITEMENT WITH APG PACE CAPTAINS KNOCK (10) is flying having landed the hat trick by leading and cruising home by 14m last week. Drops back to the mile but owns a good strike rate at it and while he draws a couple of spots deeper than last time he came from wider than this when scoring two back. RAKERO ROCKET (11) hasn't raced since March but impressed in his first Australian campaign, highlighted by two big wins at this circuit and distance along with placings in the Newcastle Mile and a Miracle Mile qualifier. He'll be ready to go off two trials, easily winning the latest so could threaten. MAX DELIGHT (8) has ground to make up on Captains Knock through the last clash but he was held up there and is capable of better. BETTER ECLIPSE (9) could be best of the rest.

CLUB MENANGLE RANJI BILL STAKES (LISTED CLASSIC) Top mare EYE KEEP SMILING (2) will relish the return to her own sex having chased Captains Knock when fourth here last start. Before that she landed the G1 Golden Girl in Brisbane for the third straight year. This is the lowest draw she has had for some time. Clearly the one to beat. LUX AETERNA (6) was runner-up to Eye Keep Smiling when they last clashed in the Golden Girl and she hasn't missed the top-three since including two Listed wins at this circuit and distance. Must respect. BELLA DANZA (7) was a beaten favourite when fourth to Lux Aeterna from this barrier last start but she did beat the top two picks when she won over the Brisbane carnival so is worth another chance. GOLLY GEE FELLAS (4) is building in fitness and has first four claims.

TAB 3YO STAKES Star colt LOUCASSO (7) makes his first Sydney appearance for new trainer Seaton Grima. Hasn't raced since a phenomenal juvenile season that saw him win the G1 Protostar in Brisbane along with a 25m romp in the Breeders Crown Final when last seen in December. Cruised home in a Newcastle trial so can pick up where he left off. ALERT BAY (3) added to a string of top-three results at this venue when he worked home late for third last time. Race fit and draws to be competitive. ONE MORE REASON (1) led from wider and missed narrowly when resuming. Hasn't missed a place when fresh and has the speed to be prominent from the ace draw. ETHANS REVENGE (4) and EYE CAN EAR AMOUR (6) are both exotic hopes.

SUCCESS STUD PACE SNAP SHOT (1) has been coming from wide barriers of late and did a good job to get within 3m off the winner at this circuit and distance last week. Worked to the front from out wide on that occasion so can take advantage of the ace draw. BARTELLO (4) returns from a stint in Brisbane and came from much wider for second the last time he raced here. Finds a suitable assignment. MICHAYWEY (9) draws wide but has been tackling higher-graded races of late so may find this more to his liking. THE METAL FLYER (2) is another that comes back in class and he was runner-up from the widest barrier in this grade two back so deserves respect from the low draw. BEST BETS:
#4 Vite Monet – Nicely placed coming back in grade.
